**Protocol:** CDISCPILOT01  |  **Population:** Safety Population  |  **Reason:** CONVENTION

**Analysis set:** `SAFFL = 'Y'`  —  Placebo N=5, Zanomaline Low N=5, Zanomaline High N=7, Total N=17

| Subject | Actual treatment | Site | Age | Sex | Date of death | Study day | Primary cause of death (SDTM DD) | Associated fatal AE | Discontinuation reason |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| CDISC002 | Zanomaline Low Dose (54 mg) | 701 | 76 | F | 2013-01-14 | 61 | SUDDEN DEATH | SUDDEN DEATH | DEATH |
| CDISC008 | Placebo | 704 | 75 | M | 2014-11-01 | 175 | COMPLETED SUICIDE | COMPLETED SUICIDE | DEATH |

---

### Notes

- LISTING — no statistical method, no summarization. One row per death (3 expected).
- DTHCAUS sourced from SDTM DD (DDTESTCD for primary cause of death); joined to ADSL by USUBJID.
- Listings are rendered directly from the subsetted ADaM, not via an ARD of statistics.
- N-GATE CAVEAT: this study has 17 randomized subjects (Placebo 5 / Low 5 / High 7). All inferential statistics are illustrative and must not be interpreted.
- Listings present subject-level records; no statistic is computed.
- All values computed from ADaM via the persisted ARD (`ard.csv`); no value is hand-entered.
- Rounding: SAS convention (half away from zero), applied at display time only.

> **N-GATE WARNING.** This study randomized 17 subjects (Placebo 5 / Zanomaline Low 5 / Zanomaline High 7). Every inferential statistic in this display is **illustrative only** and must not be interpreted as evidence of effect or of absence of effect.
